selection_criteria.deduplicate_authors: Cap at 1-2 items per author. Avoid stale Fable-5 retro frames already covered all week.
selection_criteria.prefer: Concrete news, product/model/paper releases, policy/company moves, strong practitioner observations, useful technical analysis.
selection_criteria.avoid: Weak filler, x.com only links, generic vibes posts, reposts of items covered in last 7 days.
selection_criteria.metric_priority: Engagement plus fresh angle plus traceable concrete tweet source.
